name: maybe_Battle_Popup_EnsureLargePerSlotC

name: maybe_Ui_ProfileScreen_DtorDelete
summary: Deleting destructor of a large composite UI screen: stamps the vtable, tears down the widget chain, message page, layout refs and inline object arrays, then frees the block.
evidence: Standard dtor+delete chain (vtable stamp, Ui_MessagePage_Dtor, two Ui_LayoutRef_Release, std_destroy_range, Ui_Object_DtorBase, 0x0010F6CC); no caller or vtable row identifies the concrete screen class.

name: maybe_Field_TalkBalloon_Dtor

name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DtorDeleteF

evidence: Callee Ui_Drawable_Dtor plus standard dtor+delete idiom; no vtable row or caller identifies the concrete class, identical copies at 0x003B498C/0x003B567C.

name: maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_DeleteThunk
summary: Deleting-destructor thunk of a scene-node class: stores vtable, runs Gfx_SceneNode_DtorBody and frees the block.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_ReleaseBuffers

name: maybe_Ui_Object_DeleteThunk

name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_DeletingDtor

name: maybe_Field_SpriteActor_DeletingDtor

name: maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateA

name: maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateB

evidence: Same caller set as copy A and byte-identical body apart from the table base; what the pair of tables gates is unproven.

name: maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateC
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateC(u32 layer, u32 owner, u32 value)
summary: Updates one slot of a 4-layer ownership table: under lock 0x007C865C, adjusts the global owned-layer count when the slot's owner word changes to/from 0, then stores the owner word and caller-supplied value for layer 0..3.
evidence: Callers invoke all four copies with the same layer and two value words (Gfx_MoviePlayer_Init layer 1 with a code address, Ui_LoadIconTextures layer 3, Gfx_ResetRenderer, sound shutdown); table role inferred.

name: maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateD
signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateD(u32 layer, u32 owner, u32 value)
summary: Fourth copy of the 4-layer ownership-table update (table 0x007C86BC, lock 0x007C865C): adjusts the owned-layer count when the owner word changes to/from 0, then stores the owner and caller-supplied value for the given layer.
evidence: Same caller set and arguments as copy C and the same lock 0x007C865C; the table role is still inferred from those callers.

name: maybe_Sound_ApplyCategoryBgmState

evidence: Named callees Snd_StopPendingBgm, Sound_SetVoiceGainByHandle and volume setter 0x001EE018; record is a category->mode table; callers are menu effect-param init paths.

name: maybe_Menu_SumPartyStats

name: maybe_Actor2D_ResetIfRegistered

name: maybe_Model_Actor_SetAttachSlotResource

evidence: CharacterRecord compare via 0x0063EB94, Effect_ReleaseHandle and Model_AttachSlot_InitResource are visible; the exact slot semantics remain approximate.

name: maybe_Model_Actor_SetAttachSlotHandle

name: maybe_Model_Actor_OnAttachmentChanged

evidence: Slot +0x24 of vtable 0x00776860 next to maybe_Field_Prop_UpdateChildVisibility; body calls Field_SceneObject_ReleaseEffectSlots, unregisters via work->f_54 and Effect_ReleaseHandle on +0x2D4; called from maybe_Field_SceneSpawnBlock_PropEffectInstance.

name: Gfx_SpriteNode_ReleaseEffects
summary: Release virtual of the sprite node: while active it runs the shared 2D actor notify and releases the node's effect handle at +0x2F4 from the global handle table.
evidence: Slot +0x20 of vtable 0x00773620 whose +0x30 is confident Gfx_SpriteNode_UpdateFollowOffset; body calls maybe_Actor2D_NotifyObjectHandle then Effect_ReleaseHandle on the handle; called from Gfx_SpriteNode_CtorWithMotion.

name: Field_Smithy_ReleaseSparkEffect

evidence: Slot +0x20 of vtable 0x00776530 whose +0x28 is confident Field_Smithy_UpdateSparkEffect; body calls maybe_Actor2D_NotifyObjectHandle then Effect_ReleaseHandle on sparkEffectHandle; no direct callers (vtable-only).
